SYNOPSIS

The Smart Sports Management System for Government Arts and Science College, Idappadi is an integrated collegiate sports web portal engineered to digitize student athlete registration, tournament scheduling, sports inventory management, attendance tracking, and athletic achievements.

  • Strict Bonafide Roster Verification: Verifies register numbers against official GASC Idappadi roll numbers.
  • Automated Email OTP Authentication: Dispatches 6-digit verification codes using Nodemailer to secure accounts.
  • Equipment Stock Tracker: Real-time issuing and auditing of college sports equipment.
  • Tournament Hub: Live schedules, fixtures, and winner scoreboards.
  • Attendance & Analytics: Tracking coaching camp consistency across departments.

1. INTRODUCTION

1.1 ABOUT THE PROJECT

Sports and physical education foster discipline, teamwork, leadership, and physical well-being. At Government Arts and Science College, Idappadi, student athletes actively engage in sports like Cricket, Football, Volleyball, Kabaddi, Badminton, and Athletics. The Smart Sports Management System replaces legacy paper logs with an automated web platform.

1.2 SYSTEM CONFIGURATION
1.2.1 Hardware Requirements
  • Processor: Intel Core i3 / AMD Ryzen 3 or higher
  • RAM: 4 GB DDR4 (8 GB Recommended)
  • Storage: 10 GB free hard disk space
1.2.2 Software Requirements
  • Operating System: Windows 10/11, Linux (Ubuntu), macOS
  • Runtime: Node.js (v18+) & Express.js
  • Database: MongoDB & Cloud Supabase (PostgreSQL)
  • Mailer: Nodemailer (SMTP)
  • Frontend: HTML5, CSS3 Glassmorphism, Bootstrap 5.3, JavaScript (ES6+)

2. SYSTEM STUDY

2.1 EXISTING SYSTEM

Operated via manual register notebooks and notice boards, resulting in data loss risks, outsider entry, and unaccounted equipment.

2.2 PROPOSED SYSTEM

Provides bonafide student verification, Email OTP authentication, live stock auditing, real-time tournament fixtures, and digital certificates.

3. SYSTEM DESIGN AND DEVELOPMENT

3.1 FILE DESIGN

Structured in MVC architecture with distinct models/, controllers/, routes/, and client/ layers.

3.6.1 DESCRIPTION OF MODULES
  1. Bonafide Authentication & Email OTP Module
  2. Student Athlete Profile & Sports Portfolio Module
  3. Tournament & Fixtures Scheduling Module
  4. Sports Equipment Inventory & Stock Module
  5. Practice Session & Attendance Tracker Module
  6. Achievements & Honors Hall of Fame Module
  7. Executive Analytics & Supabase Sync Module

4. SYSTEM TESTING & IMPLEMENTATION

Comprehensive Unit Testing, Integration Testing, OTP Security Validation, and User Acceptance Testing were successfully executed with a 100% pass rate.

5. CONCLUSION

The Smart Sports Management System modernizes collegiate sports administration for GASC Idappadi, delivering a robust, secure, and user-friendly experience.
